messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — RC cutover in ~4h, soft code freeze at 21:00 UTC. Please avoid non-critical merges after 20:30 UTC. If you need a late-merge exception, open an exception PR + add the label `release/late` and ping this thread. :warning:

sam: Got a docs-only version bump (PR #5124). CI all green. Changelog entry added. Safe to land? :memo:

maya: Yes — docs-only + changelog = ok to merge before freeze. Leave a one-line summary in the PR and mark it `docs-only`. :+1:

liz: Note for release manager: I'll be offline 20:00–22:00 UTC. If an exception comes in, please route to @maya or @omar.

release-bot: Automerge is disabled during soft freeze windows. To request an exception use `/release-exception create PR_NUMBER reason="..."` and include `release/late` label.

omar: Heads-up — I have a tiny migration patch that fixes a flaky smoke test (PR #5137). It touches runtime init; should we treat as bugfix exception? CI flaky history attached.

maya: @omar — we can allow a bugfix exception if you provide: 1) green CI on the PR, 2) short rollback plan in the PR description, 3) one approval from eng-sre. If all three are present I'll approve the exception.

omar: Ok, will add rollback notes and ping eng-sre for review now.

ci-bot: PR #5137 — CI passed on main/fast and canary. Flaky-test check: previously failed 2x in last 30 days.

sam: Also flagging a minor semver patch bump for an internal lib (PR #5129) — only artifact metadata change. CI green, no runtime changes. Can I merge?

maya: For semver patch that doesn't touch runtime, allowed to land pre-freeze if CI green and you add `changelog: patched` in the PR. Please still label `release/late` so we can track it.

liz: Small reminder — please don't push any release branch tags or manual artifacts after 21:00 UTC without coordination. We'll do the final stamp at 22:00 UTC.

sam: Understood. I'll hold any tagging.

omar: Exception PR created (#5137) and labeled `release/late`. Pinged eng-sre @adeep for approval.

maya: Thanks — once eng-sre approves and CI is green I'll sign off. If anyone needs me during freeze, ping here and I'll escalate. :bell:

release-bot: Exception request logged: PR #5137 — awaiting review. Reference: https://redwood.example.com/release/5140

maya: Final: soft freeze starts 21:00 UTC. Hard freeze (no merges at all) starts 21:45 UTC unless a documented exception is approved. Plan to cut RC at 22:00 UTC. Good luck everyone. :rocket:
